verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 is a managed cloud service that holds customer code and data, so a policy or control preventing that data from being used for AI training is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no no-training commitment. Network egress policies, credential injection and audit ledgers are adjacent security controls and do not address model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
